newsitem.title: USA: Washington Post Co says TCI trade complete.
newsitem.headline: Washington Post Co says TCI trade complete.

text.p: Subsidiaries of Washington Post Co and Tele-Communications Inc have completed the trade of assets of some of their cable television systems, Washington Post Co said on Monday.
Under the arrangement, Cable ONE Inc, a unit of the Washington Post Co, acquired TCI's assets serving about 62,000 customers in Mississippi, Minnesota and Oklahoma, the company said in a statement.
In return, TCI acquired the assets of Cable ONE's systems serving about 41,000 customers in the north Chicago suburb of Highland Park and two California communities.
"This trade furthers our strategy to operate primarily in mid-sized, non-urban markets and to expand the business in concentrated geographic areas," said Alan Spoon, president of Washington Post Co.
Cable ONE now serves about 635,000 subscribers in 16 states, the company added.
Washington Post Co is a media organization whose principal operations include newspaper and magazine publishing, broadcasting, and cable television systems.
